components.name: Title Staff
components.description: The five-line staff written from a title, one note per word, for stories without an image.

narrative.overview:
OJM reads as one issue of a personal magazine, made from a single person's real work. Its staff is literal: music staff lines are the recurring rule, and the notes on them stand for published posts, stories, and the bits of the name Li. The ground is pale pink, the paper is pink-white, and the type is high-contrast serif in wine ink.

Density is editorial. Large serif headings hold the space, and small Literata carries the detail. Public pages are composed asymmetrically, with paper layered and slightly rotated as if placed by hand. Reading pages drop all of that for one quiet column.

The world refuses a dark theme, dark brown or ivory as the main colour, loud gradients, heavy glassmorphism, and continuous animation.
keyCharacteristics: Pale pink ground, pink-white paper, wine ink, and one peony-wine accent.
High-contrast display serif at large sizes, with Literata for everything small or read at length.
Five-line staffs as rules, dividers, covers, and timeline.
Rotated paper layers with soft wine-tinted shadows.
Motion that answers an event and then stops.

rules.name: The Ornament Rose Rule
rules.body: Dusty Rose never carries text someone has to read; it reaches only 2.36:1 on the ground. Ornament hidden from assistive technology, such as the `{ }` and `</>` marks, may use it.

rules.name: The Wine Panel Rule
rules.body: Wine Ink fills only small, deliberate objects, such as buttons, the selected chip, the Now Playing panel, and the piano case. It never becomes a page or section ground, because OJM has no dark theme.

rules.name: The Shared Names Rule
rules.body: Token names such as `--pink-soft` and `--rose-ink` are shared with Admin through the one global stylesheet. Renaming a token changes Admin pages too, so a rename has to cover both.

rules.name: The Hairline Floor Rule
rules.body: Noto Serif Display is for sizes of about 28px and up only, because its hairlines drop out below that. Anything smaller is Literata, even when it is a heading.

rules.name: The Machine Voice Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono is only for code and binary. That covers code samples, Markdown source in the editor, bits, the `{ }` and `</>` marks, and keycaps, which name keyboard input. It never sets prose, labels, or metadata.

rules.name: The Staff Rule
rules.body: A staff is always five parallel, evenly spaced lines, whatever the scale: 6px spacing on covers and in the footer, 20px on the Moments timeline. A note on a staff always stands for something real: a bit, a word of a title, or a published item.

rules.name: The Placed Paper Rule
rules.body: Paper layers tilt by no more than 1.2deg; mascot stickers may tilt 4deg to 5deg. Layers overlap by small negative margins, so they read as stacked by hand.

rules.name: The Quiet Page Rule
rules.body: Post, chapter, Admin, and editor pages are flat. They carry no rotation or decoration in the reading or working area, and the cursor effect does not run on chapters, Admin, or the editor.

rules.name: The Stillness Rule
rules.body: There is no continuous animation. Every movement answers an event (load, scroll into view, hover, pointer movement, or playback) and then stops, and `prefers-reduced-motion` turns it off.

dos: Do use a five-line staff wherever a rule needs to feel like OJM.
Do keep Noto Serif Display at about 28px and up, and switch to Literata below that.
Do tie every note on a staff to a real bit, word, or published item.
Do keep paper tilt at 1.2deg or less, and use the Paper and Lift shadows rather than new ones.
Do cycle covers through the four cloth tokens, with the cloth overlay on top.
Do keep tap targets at 44px or more on small screens.
Do drop rotation and ornament on reading and Admin pages.
Do check Admin pages when changing a shared token.
donts: Don't add a dark theme, or make dark brown or ivory the main colour.
Don't use loud gradients. Staff lines drawn with a hard-stop repeating gradient and the violin's faint body tint are part of the world.
Don't add continuous animation, including idle loops, marquees, or autoplay.
Don't set readable text in Dusty Rose.
Don't use JetBrains Mono for prose, labels, or metadata.
Don't rename shared tokens such as `--pink-soft` or `--rose-ink` without updating Admin.
knownGaps: About 56 fixed sizes sit outside the type ramp, in public pages and Admin.
Off-scale radii sit on covers, code, keys, the small sticker and round marks.
side-tab on .cover is a false positive: the band is the book hinge.
.brand is Display at 27px, accepted as about 28px.
Below 1080px the hero drops violin and code marks; at 390px the bit staff is cropped.
Hero staff notes light by beat, not pitch.
The native date-picker icon stays browser chrome at 70% opacity.
Browser Back has no leave warning; the draft is still saved.
